name: Ahasuerus
summary: A king who reigned over 127 provinces, from India to Ethiopia, from his throne in Shushan the palace. He put away Queen Vashti, made Esther his queen, and turned against Haman when Esther revealed his plot.

key_moments.title: Defied by Queen Vashti
key_moments.description: Ahasuerus held a great feast in Shushan the palace. On its seventh day, when he was merry with wine, he sent for Queen Vashti to show off her beauty, but she refused, and he burned with anger.

key_moments.title: Crowns Esther Queen
key_moments.description: The king loved Esther more than all the other women and put the royal crown on her head in place of Vashti. Then he held a great feast for his princes and servants, called Esther's feast.

key_moments.title: Gives Haman His Ring
key_moments.description: Haman told the king of a people whose laws were different and offered silver to have them destroyed. The king gave Haman his ring and let him deal with the people as he liked.

key_moments.title: Hears How Mordecai Saved Him
key_moments.description: One night the king could not sleep, so he had the records read to him. He heard how Mordecai had exposed a plot to kill him, and learned that nothing had been done to honor him.

key_moments.title: Has Haman Hanged
key_moments.description: When Esther pleaded for her life and her people, the king asked who had dared to do this. She named Haman, and the king had him hanged on the gallows he had built for Mordecai.
